public class Cards {
    public static long MOD = 998244353;
    public static long[][] stirling;
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException{
        BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        stirling = new long[5001][5001];
        stirling[0][0] = 1;
        for(int i = 1; i < 5001; i++){
            for(int j = 1; j < 5001; j++){
                stirling[i][j] = (stirling[i-1][j-1] % MOD) + (j*stirling[i-1][j]) % MOD;
                stirling[i][j] %= MOD;
            }
        }
        String line = reader.readLine();
        String[] parts = line.split(" ");
        long n = Long.parseLong(parts[0]);
        long m = Long.parseLong(parts[1]);
        int k = Integer.parseInt(parts[2]);
        long p = modInverse(m, MOD);
        long val = 1;
        long answer = 0;
        long probability = 1;
        for(int i = k; i > 0; i--){
            val *= (n - (k - i));
            val %= MOD;
            probability *= p;
            probability %= MOD;
            answer += (((val * probability) % MOD) * stirling[k][k - i + 1]) % MOD;
            answer %= MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
    }

    public static long modInverse(long x, long p){
        return power(x, p - 2, p);
    }

    public static long power(long base, long exp, long mod){
        long result = 1;
        base = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1)
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
